HoloProt is a novel and powerful multi-scale graph representation for protein structure and sequence, which can be used for a range of downstream protein tasks, such as protein function prediction, binding affinity prediction and protein design.

HoloProt is an effective graph construction that can be used to learn multi-scale representations for proteins and that these multi-scale representations are effective in predicting protein binding affinity and function.

the multi-scale representation outperforms state-of-the-art models in all tested tasks.

the multi-scale representation is better at learning a more generalizable representation of the protein, as it is able to capture the protein’s structure and function in a more comprehensive way.
